title: Affineness is local on the target
statement:
A morphism of schemes $f:X\to S$ is
affine if and only if for every
affine open $V\subset S$ the preimage $f^{-1}(V)$ is affine, if and
only if there exists an affine open covering $S=\bigcup_jV_j$ such that
each $f^{-1}(V_j)$ is affine.
(*Stacks Project, Morphisms of Schemes, Lemma 29.11.3, Tag
[01S8](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01S8).*)
blueprint_proof_text: This is the recorded classical input named in the statement, Stacks Project, Morphisms of Schemes, Lemma 29.11.3 ([Tag 01S8](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01S8)): affineness of a morphism is local on the target in the stated sense. No separate proof is given.
